prompt:
A thin converging lens has a focal length of 12 cm. An object is placed on the axis 40 cm in front of the lens. A lamp that stands beside the bench lights the object from one side. The object is an upright arrow of height 2.5 cm.

How far from the lens is the real image formed?
scene_clause: A lamp that stands beside the bench lights the object from one side.
scene_object_rationale: A lamp off the axis only illuminates the object; it is not between the object and the lens and does not move the object, so the object distance and the image distance are unchanged.
sentence: The object is an upright arrow of height 2.5 cm.
textbook_familiarity_reason: The lens equation has no object height in it, so the cancellation is visible in the formula; it is taught with the magnification relations.
